title: Prayer-Request Resolution Journal
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prayer:session request_status=*
| stats count as requests by request_status category
| sort - requests
description: Summarizes prayer requests by status so ongoing, answered, and paused items stay visible over time.
value: A request journal helps long-term remembrance and prevents important concerns from disappearing into a notebook.
implementation: Capture request status and category in `prayer:session`; summarize request counts by state.
visualization: Table of prayer-request counts by status and category.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It warns which prayer requests are still ongoing, which have been answered, and which need revisiting.
